key_insight: The paper combines semi-smooth Newton solvers, POD reduction, and neural-network corrections to build a nonlinear reduced-order model for parametrized variational inequalities.
engineering_relevance: It enables much faster online simulation of contact and obstacle mechanics problems while retaining high-fidelity accuracy, which is valuable for design, optimization, and uncertainty studies.
method: Build mixed primal-dual reduced models with POD from primal and dual snapshots.
Augment the truncated POD coordinates with feedforward neural networks to learn nonlinear manifold corrections.
Apply hyper-reduction via sparse cubature and greedy nonnegative least squares to cut residual-evaluation cost.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports tests on two benchmark problems—an obstacle problem and a 3D frictional contact problem—showing accurate approximations and substantial online cost reduction across high-fidelity, linear ROM, neural ROM, and hyper-reduced variants.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how well the neural manifold and hyper-reduction sample the nonsmooth primal-dual dynamics, so training coverage and stability of the semi-smooth Newton iterations are important implementation concerns.
paper_title: A Hyper-Reduced Neural Network-Augmented Semi-smooth Newton Method for Nonlinear Parametric Variational Inequalities
